design_brief.description: End cap for standard HT (high-temperature) drainage pipe system, nominal diameter DN110 (110 mm). Cap provides a secure push-fit over the pipe outer diameter with an internal stop and adequate wall thickness for durability and heat resistance. Geometry is compatible with typical HT pipe/fitting interfaces.

metadata.description: Parametric end cap for DN110 HT drainage pipe: push-fit socket with internal stop, lead-in chamfer, and interference band. Includes a simple reference ht_pipe solid for fit visualization.

primary_dimension_mm.description: Primary anchor dimension (DN110 nominal / pipe OD).

pipe_od_mm.description: Pipe outer diameter (OD). Typically equals nominal diameter for DN110.

cap_top_thickness_mm.description: Closed-end thickness of the cap top.

cap_flange_radial_mm.description: Radial overhang of the top flange beyond the socket OD.

internal_stop_thickness_mm.description: Axial thickness of internal stop shoulder.

internal_stop_radial_mm.description: Radial reduction at stop (creates smaller ID at the stop).

lead_in_chamfer_depth_mm.description: Axial depth of lead-in chamfer at socket mouth.

interference_band_offset_from_mouth_mm.description: Distance from socket mouth to start of interference band.

overlap_mm.description: Small overlap used to guarantee solid connectivity.

pipe_length_ref_mm.description: Reference pipe length shown inserted into cap (for visualization).

sketch.prompt:
Draw a clean, minimalistic orthographic technical line sketch of the described object on a white background. Use thin black lines only — no shading, no color, no photorealism, no perspective distortion. Keep proportions realistic. Show the front or three-quarter view that most clearly reveals all canonical parts of the object. If helpful, label key dimensions in millimeters with small arrows, but keep labels sparse. The sketch should look like a designer's concept drawing, suitable as a reference for a parametric CAD model.

OBJECT: An HT drainage-pipe end cap with a nominal diameter of 110 mm, designed for high-temperature applications, featuring a secure fit and durable material suitable for standard HT drainage systems.
REQUIRED PARTS (must be visible in the sketch): ht_cap, ht_pipe, rd_box_cap
PROPORTIONAL CONSTRAINTS — primary_dimension = 110mm (category: generic).
All other parts of the sketch must scale consistently with this total size — no exaggerated wheels, handles, or details.
APPROX DIMENSIONS: nominal_diameter_mm≈110mm, pipe_od_mm≈110mm, pipe_wall_mm≈3.2mm, cap_wall_mm≈4.0mm, cap_insertion_depth_mm≈45mm, internal_stop_thickness_mm≈3.0mm
NOTE: Dimensions for HT DN110 vary by manufacturer; verify actual pipe OD and socket standards before finalizing interference/seal geometry. Material callout is functional intent; CAD should not include text labels.

Keep the final image below 1024x1024, clean white background, no text outside the dimension labels, no watermark.
